meta.title: Code review (OpenCodeReview)
meta.description: Brings Alibaba OpenCodeReview (ocr) into DSH: the model-callable ocr_review / ocr_status tools, the /ocr-review command and auto review when a turn ends. By default the LLM goes through a plugin-local bridge into DSH, so model, credentials and quota all stay with DSH. Optionally the review itself runs in a separate read-only subagent that hands structured findings back to the coding agent to fix.
